title: Grusch's IG complaint and AOC exchange about reverse-engineering locations

tellings.quote: you know, he's uh provided, you know, hundreds of pages to the um you know, inspector general of the intelligence community, Thomas Mannheim to the effect that there are covert reverse engineering programs.

plain: A witness named David Grusch is said to have handed hundreds of pages to Thomas Monheim, the Inspector General of the Intelligence Community, the official watchdog over US spy agencies, claiming there are covert programs taking apart and copying craft of unknown origin. The story, set in Washington between 2022 and 2023, also takes in an exchange with Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez about where such programs are located. Michels tells it in an episode with a NASA doctor, as backing for the idea that such programs exist.
